body:
Fixes #2563

Case study: [`docs/case-studies/issue-2563/README.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2563-e3ed55c6893b/docs/case-studies/issue-2563/README.md). It includes the timeline and a sanitized copy of the log from [link-foundation/command-stream#206](https://github.com/link-foundation/command-stream/pull/206).

## What happened on command-stream#206

| Comment | Problem |
| --- | --- |
| [6018754327](https://github.com/link-foundation/command-stream/pull/206#issuecomment-6018754327) (14:43:44) | First solution draft log. It has cost estimation, context and tokens usage, and models used. |
| [6018806079](https://github.com/link-foundation/command-stream/pull/206#issuecomment-6018806079) (14:46:27) | Auto-merge was held back for **#320**, an issue that does not exist in command-stream. The description says "Fixes #205". |
| [6018810946](https://github.com/link-foundation/command-stream/pull/206#issuecomment-6018810946) (14:46:43) | The same log was attached again, this time with only "Models used". The second log is the first log byte-for-byte, plus 152 lines of CI waiting. No AI session ran in between. |

## Root causes and fixes

1. **Auto-merge held back.** The pull request was created while solving link-assistant/agent#320, so its branch is `issue-320-b2913f5b1c99`. For a pull request URL, solve took the issue number from the branch name before reading the description. It logged `🔗 Found linked issue #320`, and every pre-merge gate then got HTTP 404 for command-stream#320.
   - The branch name is now only a hint (`resolvePullRequestIssueNumber`).
   - The description's same-repository closing reference wins in two cases: the description mentions the branch number only in another repository (`Unblocks link-assistant/agent#320`), or GitHub reports the branch issue as missing (404/410) or as a pull request.
   - The recovery of a deleted `Fixes #N` from #2335 is unchanged, because an existing branch issue still wins.
   - This applies to solve's PR mode, auto-continue and the pre-merge issue scope.
2. **The log was attached twice.** `attachLogAfterAutoMergeBlocked` (#2395, RC4) re-uploaded the log on every held-back merge.
   - `classifySessionResult` runs after every AI session for every tool. It now counts finished sessions, and each successful upload records how many sessions it covers (`src/log-attach-state.lib.mjs`).
   - A held-back merge no longer uploads a log that already covers every AI session; the auto-merge blocked comment explains the stop.
   - When AI work is not attached yet, the auto-merge blocked notice is placed at the top of that log comment (`leadingSection`), so the notice and the log are one comment.
3. **Obsolete format.** The re-upload passed no usage data, so only "Models used" was rendered.
   - `attachLogToGitHub` now remembers the latest usage data (`publicPricingEstimate`, `pricingInfo`, `anthropicTotalCostUSD`, `resultModelUsage`, `budgetStatsData`, plus tool, model and argv) from each finished session and each upload.
   - It fills in whatever an upload does not pass. Every upload, for every tool and every call site, therefore renders 💰 Cost estimation, 📊 Context and tokens usage and 🤖 Models used from one place.

Trade-off: the #2395 re-upload also published the non-AI tail of the log (the CI wait). That tail is no longer uploaded when there is no new AI work, because the auto-merge blocked comment already gives the reason for the stop.

## Reproduction and tests

- `node experiments/issue-2563/reproduce-branch-issue.mjs` runs `resolveSolveMode` and the pre-merge gate on the real description and branch of #206. It now selects #205 and reports no blocker. Before the fix it selected #320.
- `tests/issue-2563-primary-issue-resolution.test.mjs` (6 tests) uses a fake GitHub that answers as the real one did: #205 exists and #320 returns 404. It also checks that existing branch issues and unknown answers keep the #2335 behaviour.
- `tests/issue-2563-log-after-held-back-merge.test.mjs` (7 tests) covers:
  - A replay of the #206 sequence: there is no second upload.
  - Uploads still happen when no log was attached, when a session ran after the upload, or when the latest upload failed.
  - Sessions are counted for claude, codex, opencode and agent.
  - The notice and the log are posted as one comment, with fallbacks to the notice alone.
  - The real `attachLogToGitHub` renders all three sections for an upload that passes no usage data.
  - Without the fix, the replay fails because the log is uploaded a second time, and the format test fails with `### 💰 **Cost estimation:** missing`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh` pass. Two failures from the local `npm test` runs after merging main are fixed:
  - `extracted-modules-2198`: `solve.auto-merge.lib.mjs` had 1351 lines (ed14f08c).
  - `test-command-stream-1x-results`: a check added on main rejected the raw `stdout`/`stderr` read in `probeIssueExists` (d09087b3).

  Each of these test files passes on its own after its fix. The full suite was not re-run after the last fix.

## Unrelated CI unblock

`lino-i18n` 0.3.0 and `lino-objects-codec` 0.9.0 were released on 2026-10-07, after which the dependency freshness gate failed every branch, including `main`. Both are updated in 0dc01686, a commit of its own.
